description: Single authoritative feature registry for multimodal-artifact-poc. All feature flags (build + runtime) across rounds 1-3 and legacy/unsafe sections are defined here only. TypeScript and Python both resolve this file; never duplicate defaults in code.

features.description: Round 1 parent: multimodal + document agent suite (OCR, vision, docs, sub-agent, orchestration, evidence).
parse_image tool (PaddleOCR).
parse_visual tool (PaddleOCR-VL vision model). Heavy dependency: when disabled the vision model modules must not load.
parse_document tool (markitdown).
analyze_document tool (isolated RPC sub-agent).
analyze_document_v2 tool (two-tier orchestrator).
Evidence Quality Gate inside the V2 orchestrator. When disabled the gate is really skipped (no retry/escalate decision from quality scores).
Differentiated L1 retry on quality-gate failure. When disabled no second L1 attempt is produced.
Best-attempt selection (by quality score). When disabled an explicit ablation strategy is used: keep the LAST attempt.
L2 expert agent. When disabled the orchestrator never starts the expert agent.
Deterministic Evidence Merger. When disabled the orchestrator uses an explicit ablation output path (direct projection of the kept packet).

Round 2 parent: lakehouse data source (query gateway client + tools + evidence). Default OFF at runtime; enable with ENABLE_LAKEHOUSE=true. LAKEHOUSE_GATEWAY_URL only configures the connection, never registration.
search_catalog + inspect_dataset tools.
validate_query + execute_query tools.
get_data_quality tool; quality results must not enter query Evidence when disabled.
explain_lineage tool; lineage info must not enter Evidence when disabled.
get_snapshot tool. When disabled the standalone snapshot-analysis tool is not registered; query execution may still carry its required data-version identifier.
Conversion of query results into EvidenceFact(kind=query). When disabled results may still be returned to the caller but never become query Evidence.

Round 2 parent: Lakehouse Batch/Streaming Pipeline suite (source generation, ODS load, DWD/DWS/ADS transforms, checkpointing, dead letter, validation). Writes only via explicit CLI/E2E — never exposed as a default agent tool.
Batch pipeline: historical source files -> ODS -> DWD -> DWS -> ADS with idempotent re-run and partition-scoped writes.
Stream replay pipeline (deterministic local event replay): event replay with schema validation, event-time/watermark, event_id dedup, dead letter for invalid/too-late events, checkpoint/recovery.
Deterministic source generation (batch parquet inputs + stream events.jsonl) with source manifests and content hashes.
ODS raw landing from source files/events.
DWD clean detail transform (schema mapping, time normalization, dedup, business keys, null handling).
DWS feature/prediction subject transforms.
ADS model metrics transform computed from DWS subjects.
Checkpoint/recovery for streaming (and batch watermark) — restart resumes without duplicate consumption.
Dead-letter artifact for invalid/too-late events; never pollutes fact tables.
Pipeline validation: idempotency checks, snapshot counts, ground-truth accuracy, execution manifests.

Phase 1 parent: Data Pipeline Governance — schema discovery, SchemaSpec/PipelineSpec design, deterministic validation, review package, human approval (OPERATOR_CLI), versioned amendment. No runtime governance, placement, CDXR gate or dashboard in Phase 1.
Deterministic source schema discovery: field profile, candidate keys with evidence/confidence, event-time and sensitive candidates.
SchemaSpec draft generation (agent-assisted) with deterministic validation.
PipelineSpec draft generation (agent-assisted) with deterministic validation.
Deterministic compiler: generates a NON-EXECUTABLE PipelineDraftArtifact (executable=false) from a validated PipelineSpec before human approval.
Human approval via OPERATOR_CLI: decision binds review content hash + OS actor; approves freeze 4 content hashes; changes create new spec version + new review.
Versioned PipelineAmendment: CHANGES_REQUESTED produces new spec versions, re-compiles, re-validates and creates a new review package; old approvals never reused.
Append-only governance event store with idempotency, ordering and version control (Phase 2).
Deterministic state reducer: events -> RunStateSnapshot; the only producer of authoritative run state (Phase 2).
Event-triggered governance agent worker: reads PipelineContextPackage + RunStateSnapshot, produces findings/proposals; never resides, never writes state/approvals (Phase 2).
Spark runtime governance adapter: Job/Stage/Task structured summaries -> deterministic findings. Adapter contract + fixtures only; production Spark NOT verified.
Flink runtime governance adapter: Job/Operator/Checkpoint/Watermark/Backpressure structured summaries -> deterministic findings. Adapter contract + fixtures only; production Flink NOT verified.
Iceberg layout governance: snapshot/data-file/manifest statistics, small files, partition skew, snapshot growth -> deterministic findings.
Event-triggered deadline watchdog: heartbeat/progress renew leases; expiry produces anomaly events (never restarts/modifies pipelines).
Remediation proposals (agent-suggested) requiring operator approval (APPROVE_REMEDIATION / REQUEST_CHANGES / REJECT); never auto-applied.
Data placement governance: PlacementPlan proposal, deterministic validator, operator approval; write only after approval and only to controlled local harness targets.

DWS -> ADS / Feature Store CDXR promotion gate: triggers on DWS_FEATURE_CANDIDATE_READY, runs assess_training_data, produces FeaturePromotionReviewPackage; operator decides; only APPROVED_FOR_ADS after approval.
Multi-pipeline governance status dashboard: state projection from the reducer (single source of truth) rendered via the Pi tool UI channel (details + renderResult); never a second state store.

Round 3 parent: on-demand CDXR training-data suitability assessment (assess_training_data tool + POST /v1/cdxr/training-assessments). Default OFF at runtime. Depends on the lakehouse adapter being available.
CDXR rule group: TARGET_IN_FEATURES + LABEL_DERIVED_FEATURE (target leakage).
CDXR rule group: POST_OUTCOME_FEATURE (future-information leakage).
CDXR rule: SENSITIVE_FEATURE.
CDXR rule: TARGET_DISTRIBUTION.
CDXR rule: SAMPLE_SIZE.
CDXR rule: FEATURE_MISSINGNESS.
CDXR rule: CONSTANT_FEATURE.
CDXR rule: VALIDATION_LEAKAGE (train/validation split sanity).
CDXR rule: TRACEABILITY (snapshot reference mandatory for ALLOW).

Round 4 parent: Business Requirement Planning plugin (requirement cards, ambiguity handling, plan gate, task plans, scheduling, bounded replanning). Default OFF; when disabled the plugin registers nothing and the main agent behavior is unchanged.
Requirement Planning native Pi skill (resources_discover → skill/SKILL.md injected into the system prompt).
Isolated Planning Advisor sub-agent (strict JSON; candidate analysis only, never the decision maker).
Deterministic ambiguity detection (blocking vs non-blocking).
Clarification questions to the user (max 3). Disabled: blocking ambiguity → CANNOT_PLAN, never silent guessing.
Explicit assumption management — every default recorded with source/impact, visible to the user.
Plan gate: DIRECT / LIGHTWEIGHT / FORMAL routing.
Candidate TaskPlan generation (prepares prepare_business_task registration).
Deterministic plan validation. Semantic enhancement checks ablatable; hard invariants (schema, cycles, budgets) never disabled.
Dependency scheduler: ready/blocked/waves (no auto execution).
Parallel scheduling (multiple tasks per wave). Disabled: one task per wave.
Bounded dynamic replanning from task feedback (max 1 by default). Disabled: failures reported only.
Domain packs (generic + risk). Disabled: generic pack only, no business defaults, more clarification questions.

Round 4 parent: Data Analysis Subagent suite (task gate, materialization, subagent, script execution, artifacts, findings, charting, frontend render). Complex analysis only; simple aggregations stay on the Query Gateway.
Deterministic task gate: simple requests route to the Query Gateway; complex analysis routes to the Data Analysis Subagent.
Controlled artifact-only materialization of validated queries (POST /v1/query/materialize); immutable input artifacts for the analysis subagent.
Data Analysis Subagent in an isolated context: reads input manifest, generates AnalysisPlan, writes analysis.py, runs it via the controlled runner, returns only a summary.
Deterministic AnalysisPlan generation and validation before any script is written.
Per-run isolated workspace under ~/.pi/artifacts/data-analysis/<run-id>/ with immutable inputs/outputs.
Controlled script runner: python3 <workspace>/analysis.py with env whitelist, timeout, output caps; no -c, no heredoc, no network, no pip install.
Bounded script retry (max 2 attempts) for fixable errors only (syntax/import/result schema/numeric).
Immutable AnalysisResultArtifact + execution manifest persistence; provenance (queryId/snapshotId/scriptHash).
Structured findings from the script (never derived by the main agent); evidenceRefs point at frontend data.
Chart sections (line/bar/scatter/histogram) with bounded series data; disabled => no ChartSection in artifacts.
Frontend direct render of numeric results via the tool UI renderer (details channel). Hard boundary: when off, run_data_analysis is NOT registered and no fallback to model recitation is allowed.
run_data_analysis public tool registration (requires subagent + script execution + artifacts + frontend render).
Legacy CDXR governance CLI (python3 -m app.governance.cdxr.run). Code and tables stay; the CLI refuses to run when disabled.
Legacy CDXR governance tools + read-only governance API (get_dataset_governance_profile etc.). Default OFF.
UNSAFE ablation: disable query-plan validation. Never enabled in normal builds/runs.
UNSAFE ablation: disable sensitive-field masking. Never enabled in normal builds/runs.
UNSAFE ablation: disable ODS access control. Never enabled in normal builds/runs.
UNSAFE ablation: disable scan row limits. Never enabled in normal builds/runs.
UNSAFE ablation: allow raw data into the LLM context. Never enabled in normal builds/runs.
Round 5 parent: independent Reviewer Agent for code and data-analysis proposals.
Review package building (frozen proposal + policy snapshot).
Reviewer agent runtime (isolated Pi RPC reviewer).
Deterministic review gates (integrity/hash/replay/verdict reducer).
Code review (frozen worktree, allowlist checks, shadow tests).
Reviewer shadow tests (isolated, never committed).
Analysis review (artifact checks, replay, digest).
Analysis replay in isolated workspace.
Independent KPI recomputation (strict mode).
Semantic review via isolated LLM (findings only, no verdict).
Automatic revision loop (max 2, escalation to manual).
Frontend render of review summary/findings (UI channel).
Public reviewer tools (review_code_change / review_data_analysis / inspect_review).
Round 6 parent: deterministic Graph Engineering Runtime (compile -> execute -> review -> report).
Compile TaskPlan into an immutable GraphSpec with mandatory system nodes.
Deterministic GraphSpec validation (schema, cycles, capability, conditions).
Deterministic Graph Executor (adapter dispatch, retries, idempotency, recovery).
Deterministic wave scheduler (dependencies, artifacts, features, concurrency).
Append-only event store with hash chain and recovery.
GraphRunState projection from events.
ArtifactRef-only data edges with hash verification.
Deterministic feedback router for CHANGES_REQUIRED/ABSTAIN.
Reviewer gate/execute/authorize as graph nodes.
Skill nodes (analysis-report) without a Report Agent.
WAITING_FOR_HUMAN state; never self-approving.
Node/run metrics, attempts, routes, budgets (no numeric leakage).
UI-only graph state details channel.
run_analysis_graph + inspect_graph_run public tools.
